subject: Fundamental of Electrical and Electronics Engineering

questions.text: Find the r.m.s. and average value of the given chopped sine wave $v(t) = 10\sin t$ active between $\pi/4$ and $\pi$ in a cycle of period $2\pi$.
Determine the value of $R$, if the power dissipated in $10\,\Omega$ resistor is 90 W for the circuit shown.
Calculate the value of $R_L$ to be connected in the circuit to receive maximum power and determine the maximum power received by it.
A three phase 230V load has a power factor of 0.7. Two wattmeters are used to measure power that shows the input to be 10 kW. Find the reading of each wattmeter.

A coil of resistance $12\,\Omega$ and inductance 0.05 H, a non-inductive resistor of $20\,\Omega$ resistance and a loss-free $40\,\mu\text{F}$ capacitor are connected in series across a 240 V, 50 Hz sinusoidal supply. Calculate: (i) The current, (ii) The voltage across the coil and the capacitor, (iii) The power consumed in the circuit.
Differentiate between practical voltage source and practical current source. What are ideal and practical voltage and current sources?

The resistance of a certain length of wire is $4.60\,\Omega$ at $20^\circ\text{C}$ and $5.68\,\Omega$ at $80^\circ\text{C}$. Determine (i) the temperature coefficient of resistance of the wire at $0^\circ\text{C}$, (ii) the resistance of the wire at $60^\circ\text{C}$.

Two resistors, made of different materials having temperature coefficients of resistance $\alpha_1 = 0.004/^\circ\text{C}$ and $\alpha_2 = 0.005/^\circ\text{C}$, are connected in parallel and consume equal power at $15^\circ\text{C}$. What is the ratio of power consumed in resistance $R_2$ to that in $R_1$ at $70^\circ\text{C}$?
Use nodal analysis method to determine the node voltages $V_a$, $V_b$ and $V_c$ and calculate current through $2\,\Omega$.
State and explain Norton's theorem with a suitable example.
State superposition theorem. Use superposition theorem to find the current flowing through the $3\,\Omega$ resistor shown in figure.

A parallel circuit consists of two branches, one containing a coil of resistance $5\,\Omega$ and inductance 38.2 mH, the other a non-inductive resistance $16\,\Omega$ in series with a capacitor of $300\,\mu\text{F}$ capacitance. The circuit is connected to a 240 V, 50 Hz supply. Determine (i) the current in each branch, (ii) the total current, (iii) the circuit phase angle, (iv) the circuit impedance, (v) the components of an equivalent circuit consisting of a resistance and reactance.

Discuss the effect of low power factor. A single phase load of 7 kW operates at a power factor 0.7 lagging. It is proposed to improve the power factor to 0.9 lagging by connecting a capacitor across the load. Calculate the kVAr rating of the capacitor.

A three phase delta connected system with 400 V line voltage is connected to three unbalanced loads: $(12-j16)\,\Omega$, $(3+j4)\,\Omega$, and $20\,\Omega$, also connected in delta. Find (i) phase currents, (ii) line currents, (iii) total active power consumed.
Derive the mathematical expression for the energy stored in an electrostatic field of a capacitor: $W = \frac{1}{2} C V^2$.
How does mutual inductance between two coils depend upon the dimensions of the core and coils?
